open_blocker.finding: After first observing CSTART1, drain issues CSUSP but its bounded loop only accepts CSTART0 AND SUSP1. A finite transfer may finish normally by EOT between the busy observation and suspend request. RM does not guarantee that a request delivered after normal completion must subsequently assert SUSP. CSTART0/EOT1/TXC1/SUSP0 is a completed finite-transfer state which this branch rejects, eventually parking an active caller frame despite completed transmission. Idle cleanup can similarly report IO. This is an avoidable liveness/proof gap, not evidence of unsafe early buffer release.
official_basis: RM0433 Rev9 p2216 CR1: CSTART is cleared by EOT or acceptance of suspension; CSTART0 means master idle. CSUSP is an ongoing-transfer request.
RM0433 Rev9 p2225 SUSP: set for completion of a suspension request; no explicit guarantee for a command reaching an already completed/idle transaction.
RM0433 Rev9 section50.4.12 p2177: normal finite completion uses TXC/EOT; a suspended transmission waits CSTART clear.

Locked HAL SPI Abort lines2609..2646 waits for CSTART clear after CSUSP, then clears/checks SUSP0; it does not require observing SUSP1. This corroborates the software requirement distinction, not a hardware guarantee that SUSP can never assert.
open_blocker.actual_execution_status: Independent source/manual finding, accepted by Root for a new TDD batch. No race regression or hardware reproduction was run by this reviewer. Existing168 does not cover this event ordering.
open_blocker.required_next_exit: Add an external hardware event ordering in which finite EOT wins after observed CSTART1 and before suspension acceptance, execute the complete enlarged program to genuine RED, then minimally accept CSTART0 plus SUSP OR current finite TSIZE>0 EOT/TXC completion. Do not accept stale TXC or CSTART1. Retain independent quiet guard, RX drain, SUSP clear, SPE0, CS-high, owned SCK GPIO and reset checks. Rerun all six whole programs with a new source-bound freeze; preserve this original packet.

other_source_findings.finding: For covered normal/suspend paths, stop submitting TX, observe actual idle, wait caller-independent one-period+timer margin, read late RX within submitted prefix, clear/read SUSP, disable/read SPE0 and FIFO empty; then verify driven CS high, preserve CPOL through owned PE12 GPIO output and only then reset. CFG2 AFCNTR remains while CS is selected. Next transfer sets/checks CPOL while CS is high before AF5 handback.

Active transfer clears active only after all drain/CS/SCK/reset steps succeed. Any unproved step calls the nonreturning masked fault boundary, preserving caller frame/buffers and retained/fault state; successful CS release can clear held_cs before a later failure while active remains. Idle cleanup readback errors retain the port for retry; no error result revokes an active borrow. Poll-budget/clock-guard fault policy may itself park.

Physical route/clock/mode readbacks check an already authorized static lease, never grant one. Generated assembly owns GPIOE/PE12..14 AF5 and selected CS; hand-built private callers owe the same exclusive lifetime and serialized executor. Transfer rejects foreign SCK routing before peripheral writes/selection. Strict pristine/unlaunched cold cleanup can preserve an unrouted input/analog pad without inventing selection or taking over an unrelated route.

When SCK is still AF, sck_idle latches current CPOL then verifies GPIO output; when already this owner GPIO idle, it preserves the existing latch. Resetting CFG2 to default never requires overwriting that owned idle latch.

Submitted bytes are counted separately from completed RX. Drain copies/counts only completed RX within this call submitted prefix; extra RX is a failure before overwriting beyond prefix. Unsent queued TX may be flushed after suspension/SPE0 without claiming completion. Model late-arrival correction places EOT/tail epoch at arrival, not a later RXDR read.

Provider state/endpoint declarations are unchanged; private header changes comments only. No heap, worker, owner registry, new runtime indirection or extra state was introduced. Incoming masks are saved/restored for bounded GPIO bit updates; the fatal path intentionally never resumes.
